changelog:
- Initial release of weibo-scraper-api skill.
- Supports pulling Weibo user profiles, posts, comments, likes, reposts, and videos.
- Enables keyword search across posts, videos, users, topics, images, and provides AI-assisted answers.
- Access the hot-search board, entertainment/life/social ranking boards, and channel feeds.
- 31 structured JSON endpoints, each using 1 credit via the Scavio API.
- Requires SCAVIO_API_KEY for authentication.
display_name: Weibo Scraper API - Users, Posts, Search, Hot Search
summary: Pull Weibo user profiles and posts, post comments/likes/reposts, keyword search across posts, videos, users, topics and images, the hot-search board and ranking boards, and channel feeds. 31 endpoints, 1 credit each, structured JSON.
